title: High Probability of a Nondividing Block Value
statement: Let $M\ge12$ be a natural number and let $y\ne0$ be an integer with $|y|\le2^{5M\cdot2^M}$. Choose uniformly a bit string $s$ of length $16M^2$. For each $j=0,\ldots,8M-1$, let $r_j$ be the integer represented in little-endian order by the block of $2M$ bits of $s$ starting at position $2Mj$. Then with probability at least $3/4$, there is some such $j$ for which $r_j+1$ does not divide $y$.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a natural number with $12\le M$
